summary_rationale: Engineers India Limited combines a high-ROCE (30.4%), debt-free engineering consultancy franchise with a cyclical, working-capital-sensitive turnkey EPC business. Its core competitive moat rests on six decades of hydrocarbon process engineering across 20 of India's 23 refineries, 40+ proprietary process technologies, and 58 granted patents, which now underpin a record ₹20,421 crore order book (September 2026) weighted 75% toward higher-margin Consultancy and ~55–60% toward overseas mandates such as Dangote in Africa. However, the business earns a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than compounder classification because 5-year sales growth lagged at 4.55% prior to FY26, Turnkey segment margins swing sharply across project lifecycles (3% in FY22–FY23 to 17% in FY26 and 4% in Q2 FY27), operating cash conversion is uneven (ranging from -₹113 crore in FY23 to ₹319 crore in FY26), and non-operating treasury and dividend income accounted for 27% of consolidated PBT in FY26 (₹242 crore of ₹894 crore) and 33% on a trailing twelve-month basis. KPI health is rated PASS given record order inflows of ₹8,100 crore in FY27 to date, consultancy revenue mix expanding to 68% in H1 FY27, and the Ramagundam Fertilizers JV turning profitable with ₹63 crore profit share in H1 FY27.
